# AI Developer Cards

> AI Developer Cards is a physical card deck and companion app with 45+ methods across 9 quests for AI-assisted software development. Created by Ingo Eichhorst and Ralf D. Mueller.

## About
AI Developer Cards teaches modern software engineers how to build, modernize, and ship software using AI coding agents, prompt engineering patterns, and structured development methodologies. Developed from insights gathered across 100+ developer workshops.

## Topics Covered
- Vibe Prototyping: Rapid AI-assisted prototyping methods
- Greenfield MVP: Structured AI-first project setup
- AI-Enabled Systems: LLMs as first-class software components
- Production Grade: Hardening AI-generated code for production
- Legacy Modernization: AI-assisted strangler pattern for legacy systems
- Agentic Coding: Single AI agent orchestration
- Multi-Agent Coding: Parallel AI agent workflows
- Reinforcement Loop: Compounding AI context across sessions
- AI Software Hardening: Compliance and quality gates for AI code

## Authors
- Ingo Eichhorst: AI architect, CTO, engineering trainer, 100+ AI workshops, GitHub Copilot beta tester (2021)
- Ralf D. Mueller: Software architect, docToolchain creator, arc42 maintainer, Software-Architektur.TV co-host, iX Magazine author
